author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂 See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍 For character art, more realistic epic fantasy concept art. For the map, detailed immersive classic fantasy-map feel. Open to different styles, bonus for POC and variety of ethnicities.

author: maitespena
title: Looking for illustrators for book character promo images
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. (Adult novel with some non-human characters, simple style with humor touch)
